description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to log into a service that accepts remote connections, such as telnet, SSH, and VNC. The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.

falco.trigger_condition: Inbound TCP connection to sentinelmesh-database on port 5432 from a source IP not listed in the sentinelmesh_db_allowed_clients macro — i.e., any connection source other than the authorized webapp and authservice containers

mitigation: Restrict pg_hba.conf to explicitly named hosts or IP ranges rather than using the 'trust' authentication method. Use md5 or scram-sha-256 authentication for all network-accessible PostgreSQL connections. Segment the database network so only authorized application containers can reach it. Audit all inbound database connections and alert on sources not in the allowlist.
